status: supervised-learning-loop-specification; not evidence that 15 autonomous processes are running
budget_policy: ₹0 default; no paid APIs, subscriptions, or new external dependencies without explicit approval
execution_policy: Native Python and deterministic fixtures first; each agent is a versioned specialist profile until a tested runner exists
learning_loop: Observe a completed task and collect only permitted evidence
Normalize input/output and record source, timestamp, agent_version, prompt_version, model_version if known, and source_commit
Score output using deterministic checks plus rubric-based human review
Record errors, missing evidence, safety issues, and corrections
Add anonymized regression fixtures only when lawful and useful
Propose one minimal prompt/rule/code change with rationale
Run offline regression suite against baseline and candidate
Accept only if quality improves or remains equal with no safety regression
Human reviews meaningful behavior, permissions, and external-action changes
Version and retain rollback path; never silently self-modify or train model weights
